key: hi crim ily
en: hi crim ily
ja: やあ、クリム、あいしてるよ

key: your maps are great and so are you
en: your maps are great and so are you
ja: あんたのマップ最高だし、あんたも最高だよ

key: cries ily
en: cries ily
ja: 泣きながら、あいしてる

key: ???: Hmph... It's about time you woke up.
en: ???: Hmph... It's about time you woke up.
ja: ???: フン……ようやくお目覚めか。

key: Certainly took your sweet time, didn’t you?
en: Certainly took your sweet time, didn’t you?
ja: ずいぶんとゆっくりだったね。

key: You must've had quite the misstep, ending up in such a desolate corner of the dream.
en: You must've had quite the misstep, ending up in such a desolate corner of the dream.
ja: こんな荒れ果てた夢の片隅に迷い込むとは、よほどの失態があったに違いない。

key: ???: Oh, please. Don't look so alarmed.
en: ???: Oh, please. Don't look so alarmed.
ja: ???: おいおい、そんなに警戒しないでくれよ。

key: You being here was certainly no intention of mine.
en: You being here was certainly no intention of mine.
ja: 君がここにいるのは、僕の意図したことじゃないんだ。

key: Unfortunately, upon seeing you, you're certainly not who I was looking for.
en: Unfortunately, upon seeing you, you're certainly not who I was looking for.
ja: 残念だけど、見たところ、君は僕が探していた人物じゃなさそうだ。

key: How disappointing.
en: How disappointing.
ja: がっかりだよ。

key: In fact, if I had interest in you, you would've been aware far longer ago.
en: In fact, if I had interest in you, you would've been aware far longer ago.
ja: 実際、君に興味があったなら、もっとずっと前に気づいていたはずだしね。

key: Well, that was a waste of time.
en: Well, that was a waste of time.
ja: まあ、時間の無駄だったな。

key: Another day, another failure.
en: Another day, another failure.
ja: また今日も、空振りか。

key: It’s been fun chatting.
en: It’s been fun chatting.
ja: 話せて楽しかったよ。

key: I’m sure you can find your way back home easily enough.
en: I’m sure you can find your way back home easily enough.
ja: 家に帰る道くらい、簡単に見つけられるだろう。

key: Good luck with that.
en: Good luck with that.
ja: せいぜい頑張ってくれ。

key: ???: Oh, come on. Don't look at me like that.
en: ???: Oh, come on. Don't look at me like that.
ja: ???: おいおい、そんな目で見ないでくれよ。

key: It’s not my fault you were dragged here, and it’s certainly not my responsibility to send you back.
en: It’s not my fault you were dragged here, and it’s certainly not my responsibility to send you back.
ja: 君がここに連れてこられたのは僕のせいじゃないし、君を送り返すのも僕の責任じゃない。

key: ???: Oh, Aipom... You're back.
en: ???: Oh, Aipom... You're back.
ja: ???: おや、エイパム……戻ってきたのか。

key: Everyone seems to take their time around here.
en: Everyone seems to take their time around here.
ja: ここでは、みんな時間がかかるみたいだね。

key: Hmm? Something the matter?
en: Hmm? Something the matter?
ja: うん? どうかしたのか?

key: Oh, I see... You're hungry again.
en: Oh, I see... You're hungry again.
ja: ああ、なるほど……また腹が減ったのか。

key: Ugh... Okay, look...
en: Ugh... Okay, look...
ja: はぁ……いいだろう、聞いてくれ……

key: I'm a fair man, so I can strike you a bargain.
en: I'm a fair man, so I can strike you a bargain.
ja: 僕は公平な男だからね、取引に応じてやろう。

key: My Aipom clearly has an eye for a snack, and I certainly can't be bothered searching this dreary dystopia to satiate its... exquisite tastes.
en: My Aipom clearly has an eye for a snack, and I certainly can't be bothered searching this dreary dystopia to satiate its... exquisite tastes.
ja: うちのエイパムは食べ物にうるさくてね、こんな陰気なディストピアを探し回って、その……ぜいたくな舌を満たしてやる気にはなれないんだ。

key: So, Trainer...
en: So, Trainer...
ja: だから、トレーナー……

key: You find some Nanab Berries for my Aipom; say... three of them, and I'll show you the way back home.
en: You find some Nanab Berries for my Aipom; say...  three of them, and I'll show you the way back home.
ja: 僕のエイパムのために、ナナのみを見つけてきてくれ。そうだな……三個くらいでいい。そうしたら、帰り道を教えてやろう。

key: Sound fair?
en: Sound fair?
ja: 悪くない話だろう?

key: It better, because I doubt you're getting home without me.
en: It better, because I doubt you're getting home without me.
ja: そうであってほしいね。僕なしじゃ、家に帰れないだろうから。

key: I'll be waiting just a bit further up.
en: I'll be waiting just a bit further up.
ja: もう少し先で待ってるよ。

key: To be honest, Trainer... you've got me thinking.
en: To be honest, Trainer... you've got me thinking.
ja: 正直言うと、トレーナー……君のおかげで考えさせられたよ。

key: What I saw was quite peculiar, really.
en: What I saw was quite peculiar, really.
ja: 僕が見たものは、実に奇妙だった。

key: You’re not quite the Trainer we need, but at the very least... you’ve raised my curiosity.
en: You’re not quite the Trainer we need, but at the very least... you’ve raised my curiosity.
ja: 君は僕たちが必要としているトレーナーではないけど、少なくとも……好奇心はそそられたよ。

key: Hmph...
en: Hmph...
ja: フン……

key: The name's Shiv.
en: The name's Shiv.
ja: 名前はシヴだ。

key: And yours?
en: And yours?
ja: 君の名前は?

key: Your name is... Lin?
en: Your name is... Lin?
ja: 君の名前は……リン?

key: Hah! What kind of name is Lin?!
en: Hah! What kind of name is Lin?!
ja: ハッ! リンって、一体どんな名前だよ!

key: It sounds like something you just made up on the spot.
en: It sounds like something you just made up on the spot.
ja: その場ででっち上げたみたいな名前だな。

key: Honestly, the longer I talk to you, the stranger you become.
en: Honestly, the longer I talk to you, the stranger you become.
ja: 正直、話せば話すほど、君は奇妙になっていくね。

key: Hmph... Maybe you really do belong here.
en: Hmph... Maybe you really do belong here.
ja: フン……本当に、君はここにふさわしいのかもしれない。

key: Anyway... uh, Lin...
en: Anyway... uh, Lin...
ja: とにかく……えっと、リン……

key: Look, I said I’d let you leave, and I’m certainly a man of my word...
en: Look, I said I’d let you leave, and I’m certainly a man of my word...
ja: いいか、君を帰すと言ったし、僕は確かに約束を守る男だ……

key: However, before you go, I want a first-hand experience of how you battle.
en: However, before you go, I want a first-hand experience of how you battle.
ja: でも、行く前に、君のバトルを実際にこの目で見ておきたい。

key: Doesn’t sound too difficult, right?
en: Doesn’t sound too difficult, right?
ja: そう難しい話でもないだろう?

key: After those three battles you endured...
en: After those three battles you endured...
ja: あの三回の戦いを乗り越えてきたんだから……

key: How tough can little old me be?
en: How tough can little old me be?
ja: この僕くらい、大したことないだろう?

key: Well, I’d ask what your choice is...
en: Well, I’d ask what your choice is...
ja: まあ、選択を聞くまでもないけど……

key: But obviously, you don’t have one.
en: But obviously, you don’t have one.
ja: どうせ、選ぶ余地なんてないんだからね。

key: Let me know when you’ve prepared yourself, and we’ll get this show on the road.
en: Let me know when you’ve prepared yourself, and we’ll get this show on the road.
ja: 準備ができたら教えてくれ。始めるとしよう。

key: And please, don’t dawdle...
en: And please, don’t dawdle...
ja: それと、あんまりぐずぐずしないでくれよ……

key: You took long enough to do everything else around here.
en: You took long enough to do everything else around here.
ja: ここでのほかのことにも、もう十分時間をかけただろう。

key: SHIV: I’m glad you took the time to prepare, Lin.
en: SHIV: I’m glad you took the time to prepare, Lin.
ja: シヴ: 準備に時間をかけてくれてうれしいよ、リン。

key: But to be honest... I don’t know why you bothered.
en: But to be honest... I don’t know why you bothered.
ja: でも正直……なんでそんなことしたのか、僕にはわからないけどね。

key: It won’t make any difference in the slightest.
en: It won’t make any difference in the slightest.
ja: 何も変わりはしないんだから。

key: After all... this dream isn’t yours alone.
en: After all... this dream isn’t yours alone.
ja: だって……この夢は君だけのものじゃないんだよ。

key: Well, color me surprised.
en: Well, color me surprised.
ja: いやはや、驚かされたよ。

key: SHIV: Well... that certainly wasn't supposed to happen.
en: SHIV: Well... that certainly wasn't supposed to happen.
ja: シヴ: まあ……そんなはずじゃなかったんだけどね。

key: Everyone finds themselves surprised at one point or another...
en: Everyone finds themselves surprised at one point or another...
ja: 誰だって、時にはびっくりさせられるものさ……

key: Even me.
en: Even me.
ja: 僕だってね。

key: No matter.
en: No matter.
ja: まあ、いいさ。

key: As I said before, any amount of preparation wouldn't matter in the slightest.
en: As I said before, any amount of preparation wouldn't matter in the slightest.
ja: さっきも言った通り、どれだけ準備したところで、何も変わりはしないんだから。

key: You have your tricks... and I have mi\^
en: You have your tricks... and I have mi\^
ja: 君には君の小細工があって……僕には僕の\^

key: SHIV: Okay, so perhaps the scales were somewhat tipped out of your favor.
en: SHIV: Okay, so perhaps the scales were somewhat tipped out of your favor.
ja: シヴ: まあ、多少は君に不利な方にてんびんが傾いていたかもしれないな。

key: But I suppose I never lied, did I?
en: But I suppose I never lied, did I?
ja: でも、うそはついてないだろう?

key: It's not every time that I get to have my fun with such a peculi\^
en: It's not every time that I get to have my fun with such a peculi\^
ja: こんなに奇妙な相手で楽しめる機会なんて、そうそうない\^

key: I thought you would've already been dealt with for good.
en: I thought you would've already been dealt with for good.
ja: もうとっくに片が付いてると思ってたのに。

key: Once again, you continue to raise my curiosity.
en: Once again, you continue to raise my curiosity.
ja: またしても、君は僕の好奇心をそそるね。

key: Such a shame that you’re not the one we're looking for...
en: Such a shame that you’re not the one we're looking for...
ja: 君が、僕たちの探している相手じゃないのが、実に残念だよ……

key: Whatever the case, I suppose you've been messed with enough.
en: Whatever the case, I suppose you've been messed with enough.
ja: いずれにせよ、君はもう十分もてあそばれただろう。

key: You’re clearly a cut above the average folk skulking around this world, so perhaps you deserve just the slightest touch of respect.
en: You’re clearly a cut above the average folk skulking around this world, so perhaps you deserve just the slightest touch of respect.
ja: 君は明らかに、この世界をうろつく凡人たちより一段上の存在だ。だから、ほんの少しくらいは敬意を払ってもいいかもしれない。

key: You know, maybe I went a little far, putting you through such a long-winded ordeal...
en: You know, maybe I went a little far, putting you through such a long-winded ordeal...
ja: 思えば、こんな長々とした試練を君に課すのは、少しやり過ぎだったかもね……

key: After all, you fell into this dream purely by accident, didn’t you?
en: After all, you fell into this dream purely by accident, didn’t you?
ja: だって、君はただの偶然でこの夢に落ちてきたんだろう?

key: So... how could I possibly make it up to you, hmm?
en: So... how could I possibly make it up to you, hmm?
ja: じゃあ……どうやって埋め合わせをしようか、うーん?

key: Hmm... Well...
en: Hmm... Well...
ja: うーん……そうだな……

key: There is one thing, perhaps.
en: There is one thing, perhaps.
ja: 一つ、思いつくことがある。

key: Of course, what is the most useful thing that could be given to a budding trainer, such as yourself?
en: Of course, what is the most useful thing that could be given to a budding trainer, such as yourself?
ja: 当然、君のような駆け出しのトレーナーに与えて一番役に立つものと言えば、何だと思う?

key: The answer is clearly a Pokémon, hmm?
en: The answer is clearly a Pokémon, hmm?
ja: 答えは明らかに、ポケモンだろう?

key: Hmph, indeed... but which one?
en: Hmph, indeed... but which one?
ja: フン、その通り……でも、どれにしようか?

key: When you have the talents I do... you could pick anything, really.
en: When you have the talents I do... you could pick anything, really.
ja: 僕ほどの才能があれば……本当に何でも選べるんだけどね。

key: But I imagine you’d want something at least... well, serviceable.
en: But I imagine you’d want something at least... well, serviceable.
ja: でも君には、せめて……そうだな、実用的なものが欲しいだろう。

key: Perhaps something from the dream that will help you to keep me in your thoughts once you’re gone,
en: Perhaps something from the dream that will help you to keep me in your thoughts once you’re gone,
ja: この夢の中のもので、君が去った後も僕のことを思い出せるようなもの、

key: Not that you needed any help with that.
en: Not that you needed any help with that.
ja: まあ、そんな助けは必要ないだろうけどね。

key: Something obviously stronger than you...
en: Something obviously stronger than you...
ja: 明らかに君より強くて……

key: But with an equally cunning side...
en: But with an equally cunning side...
ja: 同じくらいずる賢い一面もある……

key: Perhaps...
en: Perhaps...
ja: そうだな……

key: A Darkrai, then?
en: A Darkrai, then?
ja: じゃあ、ダークライにしようか?

key: Hmph... Yes.
en: Hmph... Yes.
ja: フン……そうだ。

key: I think that'll suit quite nicely.
en: I think that'll suit quite nicely.
ja: それがぴったりだと思うよ。

key: SHIV: Don't get ahead of yourself though.
en: SHIV: Don't get ahead of yourself though.
ja: シヴ: でも、調子に乗らないでくれよ。

key: This isn't some kind of all-powerful Darkrai, you know.
en: This isn't some kind of all-powerful Darkrai, you know.
ja: これは、何でもできる万能なダークライってわけじゃないんだから。

key: You’re in your own head if you think you deserve a Pokémon like that.
en: You’re in your own head if you think you deserve a Pokémon like that.
ja: そんなポケモンにふさわしいなんて思ってるなら、それは君の思い込みだ。

key: This one should be good enough, to be sure, but training it, and melding it into something useful in battle...
en: This one should be good enough, to be sure, but training it, and melding it into something useful in battle...
ja: こいつで十分ではあるだろうけど、育てて、戦いで役立つように鍛え上げるのは……

key: That’s your responsibility.
en: That’s your responsibility.
ja: 君の仕事だよ。

key: What a strange day this has turned out to be...
en: What a strange day this has turned out to be...
ja: 実に奇妙な一日になったものだ……

key: And what an unusual Trainer you are.
en: And what an unusual Trainer you are.
ja: 君も、実に変わったトレーナーだよ。

key: I’m not entirely sure where you’ve come from, but it’s certainly a different land from what I call home, at least.
en: I’m not entirely sure where you’ve come from, but it’s certainly a different land from what I call home, at least.
ja: 君がどこから来たのか、正確にはわからないけど、少なくとも、僕の故郷とは全然違う土地なのは確かだね。

key: Now, with all that aside...
en: Now, with all that aside...
ja: さて、それはさておき……

key: I suppose it's time to send you home, isn't it?
en: I suppose it's time to send you home, isn't it?
ja: そろそろ、君を家に送り返す時間だろう?

key: After all, you've been dreaming for far too long.
en: After all, you've been dreaming for far too long.
ja: だって、君はもう長く夢を見過ぎてる。

key: I'd say we'll be in touch...
en: I'd say we'll be in touch...
ja: 「また連絡するよ」とでも言いたいところだけど……

key: But I suspect you'll never see me again.
en: But I suspect you'll never see me again.
ja: 君はもう、二度と僕には会わないだろうね。

key: Farewell then.
en: Farewell then.
ja: それじゃあ、さらばだ。

key: CAMERUPT: Camah?!
en: CAMERUPT: Camah?!
ja: バクーダ: バクー!?

key: CARAH!!!
en: CARAH!!!
ja: バクァァ!!!

key: ...What's this?
en: ...What's this?
ja: ……これは?

key: \v[722] left!
en: \v[722] left!
ja: \v[722]が去った!

key: That's all of them!
en: That's all of them!
ja: これで全部だ!

key: An inactive machine.
en: An inactive machine.
ja: 動いていない機械。

key: There's nothing written here.
en: There's nothing written here.
ja: ここには何も書かれていない。

key: Mine? Mine? Mine?
en: Mine? Mine? Mine?
ja: マネ? マネ? マネ?

key: TANGROWTH: Tahn.
en: TANGROWTH: Tahn.
ja: モジャンボ: モジャ。

key: Grah.
en: Grah.
ja: ンボ。

key: ANNA: Hi, \PN!
en: ANNA: Hi, \PN!
ja: アンナ: やっほー　\PN!

key: I didn't expect to see you here!
en: I didn't expect to see you here!
ja: まさかここで会うなんて思わなかった!

key: You still remember me, right?
en: You still remember me, right?
ja: まだ私のこと覚えてるよね?

key: ...Because, it seems like not many others do.
en: ...Because, it seems like not many others do.
ja: ……だって、他のみんなはあんまり覚えてないみたいだから。

key: I'm grateful that I could even be here to meet you again, after everything.
en: I'm grateful that I could even be here to meet you again, after everything.
ja: こんなにいろいろあった後で、また会えるだけでもありがたいよ。

key: Nostra had warned me that I might one day disappear, just like that boy.
en: Nostra had warned me that I might one day disappear, just like that boy.
ja: ノストラが、いつかあの男の子と同じように私も消えるかもしれないって、前に警告してくれてたの。

key: But I didn't think it'd happen just from that--
en: But I didn't think it'd happen just from that--
ja: でも、まさかあれだけのことで起きるなんて思ってなかった――

key: Just from trying to shove a tiny bit of space together...
en: Just from trying to shove a tiny bit of space together...
ja: ほんの少し空間を押し込もうとしただけで……

key: ...Pathetic, isn't it?
en: ...Pathetic, isn't it?
ja: ……情けないよね?

key: But I'm still here!
en: But I'm still here!
ja: でも、私はまだここにいる!

key: The fact that I'm in this space proves that I'm still in your heart too!
en: The fact that I'm in this space proves that I'm still in your heart too!
ja: 私がこの空間にいるってことは、まだあなたの心の中にもいるってことの証拠だよ!

key: Together, we'll defeat Lin once and for all!
en: Together, we'll defeat Lin once and for all!
ja: 一緒に、今度こそリンを倒そう!

key: Hey, hey, \PN, did you know?
en: Hey, hey, \PN, did you know?
ja: ねえねえ、\PN、知ってた?

key: In addition to the four crystal keys that sealed the Meteor and New World, there were actually two more...
en: In addition to the four crystal keys that sealed the Meteor and New World, there were actually two more...
ja: メテオとニューワールドを封じた四つの結晶の鍵のほかに、実はもう二つあったの……

key: The Gold and Ivory Keys...
en: The Gold and Ivory Keys...
ja: 金と象牙の鍵……

key: Unlike the others, they were never sold or shaped into jewelry...
en: Unlike the others, they were never sold or shaped into jewelry...
ja: 他の鍵と違って、売られたり宝飾品に加工されたりはしなかった……

key: But they might be pretty if they were!
en: But they might be pretty if they were!
ja: でも、もしそうしてたら、きっときれいだったろうね!

key: These two keys are said to unlock the true secrets of Arceus!
en: These two keys are said to unlock the true secrets of Arceus!
ja: この二つの鍵は、アルセウスの本当の秘密を開くって言われてるの!

key: \PN, you have to find them no matter what!
en: \PN, you have to find them no matter what!
ja: \PN、絶対にそれを見つけなきゃだめだよ!

key: And fast, okay?
en: And fast, okay?
ja: それも早くね、いい?

key: I've got a feeling something bad is coming soon...
en: I've got a feeling something bad is coming soon...
ja: なんだか、もうすぐ悪いことが起きる気がするの……

key: I know you can do it, \PN!
en: I know you can do it, \PN!
ja: \PNならできるって信じてる!

key: We've come so far!
en: We've come so far!
ja: ここまで頑張ってきたんだから!

key: I'm sorry I'm still asleep on the other side!
en: I'm sorry I'm still asleep on the other side!
ja: 向こう側でまだ眠ったままで、ごめんね!

key: I super-ultra double-- no, triple pinky promise that I'm doing my best to wake up!
en: I super-ultra double-- no, triple pinky promise that I'm doing my best to wake up!
ja: 超ウルトラ二重――ううん、三重の指切りで約束する、目を覚ますために全力を尽くしてるって!

key: I'm not sure where I'll find the third pinky, but I'll manage somehow!
en: I'm not sure where I'll find the third pinky, but I'll manage somehow!
ja: 三本目の小指がどこにあるのかはわからないけど、なんとかするから!

key: It seems like everything I did to try and manage the timeline enough so you could beat Lin took a toll on me...
en: It seems like everything I did to try and manage the timeline enough so you could beat Lin took a toll on me...
ja: あなたがリンを倒せるように時間軸を管理しようと頑張ったこと、全部私に負担をかけてたみたい……

key: But to be honest, I think it could've been a lot worse!
en: But to be honest, I think it could've been a lot worse!
ja: でも正直、もっとひどいことになってたかもしれないと思う!

key: If I had done more, I may not have been able to be there at all...
en: If I had done more, I may not have been able to be there at all...
ja: もっとやってたら、そもそもあそこにいられなかったかもしれないし……

key: And then I'd miss all of you terribly!
en: And then I'd miss all of you terribly!
ja: そしたら、みんなのことすごく恋しくなってたよ!

key: I know you can finish the job even without me though!
en: I know you can finish the job even without me though!
ja: 私がいなくても、あなたならやり遂げられるって知ってる!

key: You've come so far!
en: You've come so far!
ja: ここまで来たんだから!

key: Just a little further, and we'll defeat Lin for good!!!
en: Just a little further, and we'll defeat Lin for good!!!
ja: あと少しで、リンを完全に倒せる!!!

key: ANNA: Oh, do you need some help?
en: ANNA: Oh, do you need some help?
ja: アンナ: あ、助けが必要?

key: It seems like there's a lot of bad things from your memories here.
en: It seems like there's a lot of bad things from your memories here.
ja: ここには、あなたの記憶の中の嫌なものがたくさんあるみたいだね。

key: But that means there's no better place to triumph over them!
en: But that means there's no better place to triumph over them!
ja: でも、だからこそ、それを乗り越えるのにこれ以上の場所はないよ!

key: Let me heal your Pokémon!
en: Let me heal your Pokémon!
ja: ポケモンを回復させてあげる!

key: ANNA: There! You're all spick and span!
en: ANNA: There! You're all spick and span!
ja: アンナ: はい! これでピカピカだよ!

key: Do you also need to swap out some Pokémon?
en: Do you also need to swap out some Pokémon?
ja: ポケモンを入れ替えたりもする?

key: ANNA: No problem, we should be able to do that here!
en: ANNA: No problem, we should be able to do that here!
ja: アンナ: 大丈夫、ここでもできるはずだよ!

key: Just close your eyes and focus reaaaaaaalllll hard!
en: Just close your eyes and focus reaaaaaaalllll hard!
ja: 目を閉じて、めちゃくちゃ集中してね!

key: ANNA: All right, you've got this!
en: ANNA: All right, you've got this!
ja: アンナ: よし、大丈夫、あなたならできる!

key: Go give 'em the old one-two!
en: Go give 'em the old one-two!
ja: いっちょ、ガツンとかましてきて!

key: ???: Ahh, you’re back from your expedition, I take it?
en: ???: Ahh, you’re back from your expedition, I take it?
ja: ???: ああ、探索から戻ってきたみたいだね?

key: You look exhausted, Trainer.
en: You look exhausted, Trainer.
ja: 疲れ果てているようだね、トレーナー。

key: Come on, what’s so difficult about finding a few berries?
en: Come on, what’s so difficult about finding a few berries?
ja: まったく、木の実をいくつか見つけるだけで、何がそんなに難しいんだ?

key: Hmph... I suppose berry-hunting is just a touch harder for some.
en: Hmph... I suppose berry-hunting is just a touch harder for some.
ja: フン……木の実探しっていうのは、人によっては少し難しいものなのかもね。

key: Well, I don’t have all day, so you’d best show me what you’ve found.
en: Well, I don’t have all day, so you’d best show me what you’ve found.
ja: まあ、僕もそんなに暇じゃないから、見つけたものを早く見せてくれ。

key: ???: Is something the matter?
en: ???: Is something the matter?
ja: ???: どうかしたのか?

key: Where are the berries?
en: Where are the berries?
ja: 木の実はどこだ?

key: Oh, you don't have any?
en: Oh, you don't have any?
ja: おや、一つもないのか?

key: Come now, Trainer. Why didn't you mention that from the start?
en: Come now, Trainer. Why didn't you mention that from the start?
ja: おいおい、トレーナー。最初からそう言ってくれよ。

key: How bold of me to assume we were finishing up here...
en: How bold of me to assume we were finishing up here...
ja: もう終わりだと思い込むなんて、僕もずいぶん気が早かったな……

key: Well, that's disappointing.
en: Well, that's disappointing.
ja: まったく、がっかりだよ。

key: I thought bringing me three relatively common berries would amount to being quite a simple task.
en: I thought bringing me three relatively common berries would amount to being quite a simple task.
ja: 比較的よくある木の実を三つ持ってくるだけの、簡単な仕事だと思ってたんだけどね。

key: Now you're just wasting my time.
en: Now you're just wasting my time.
ja: これじゃ、ただ僕の時間を無駄にしてるだけだ。

key: I can say with certainty now that you’re not who I was looking for.
en: I can say with certainty now that you’re not who I was looking for.
ja: もう確信を持って言えるよ、君は僕が探していた相手じゃないってね。

key: Well, I guess you’d best keep up your search.
en: Well, I guess you’d best keep up your search.
ja: まあ、探し続けた方がいいだろうね。

key: I’ll be waiting... but the clock is ticking.
en: I’ll be waiting... but the clock is ticking.
ja: 待ってるよ……でも、時間は刻一刻と過ぎていく。

key: ???: Still no berries?
en: ???: Still no berries?
ja: ???: まだ木の実はないのか?

key: You better get moving, if you ever want to wake up again.
en: You better get moving, if you ever want to wake up again.
ja: もう一度目を覚ましたいなら、さっさと動いた方がいいぞ。

key: Or not,
en: Or not,
ja: それとも、

key: Be my guest.
en: Be my guest.
ja: 好きにするといい。

key: ???: Well, well... What a surprise.
en: ???: Well, well... What a surprise.
ja: ???: おやおや……これは驚いた。

key: You didn't get lost trying to find me.
en: You didn't get lost trying to find me.
ja: 僕を探して迷子にはならなかったんだね。

key: That's a good start, at least.
en: That's a good start, at least.
ja: 少なくとも、幸先はいいスタートだ。

key: Unfortunately, it would appear that you didn’t quite creep over the mental hurdle of remembering to find me those Nanab Berries.
en: Unfortunately, it would appear that you didn’t quite creep over the mental hurdle of remembering to find me those Nanab Berries.
ja: 残念だけど、ナナのみを見つけてくるっていう、精神的なハードルはまだ越えられていないみたいだね。

key: At this rate, I wouldn’t be optimistic about your chances of getting home.
en: At this rate, I wouldn’t be optimistic about your chances of getting home.
ja: このままだと、君が家に帰れる見込みについては、あまり楽観的にはなれないな。

key: ???: You’re back... with only one berry.
en: ???: You’re back... with only one berry.
ja: ???: 戻ってきたのか……木の実は一つだけで。

key: I think it would’ve been more fun if you still had none.
en: I think it would’ve been more fun if you still had none.
ja: 一つも持ってこなかった方が、まだ面白かったかもね。

key: That way, I could’ve made things much more interesting for you.
en: That way, I could’ve made things much more interesting for you.
ja: そうすれば、君のためにもっと面白くしてやれたのに。

key: Hurry up, find the other two berries, would you?
en: Hurry up, find the other two berries, would you?
ja: 早く、残り二つの木の実を見つけてきてくれよ?

key: ???: You’ve got two berries, huh?
en: ???: You’ve got two berries, huh?
ja: ???: 木の実が二つになったのか、なるほど?

key: One more to go, right?
en: One more to go, right?
ja: あと一つだね?

key: Good for you, Trainer.
en: Good for you, Trainer.
ja: よくやったな、トレーナー。

key: One step at a time, right?
en: One step at a time, right?
ja: 一歩ずつ、だろう?

key: Must be hard...
en: Must be hard...
ja: 大変なんだろうね……

key: I’ll be waiting... but not for much longer.
en: I’ll be waiting... but not for much longer.
ja: 待ってるよ……でも、そう長くはないぞ。

key: ???: I'm going to assume you haven't found those berries, have you?
en: ???: I'm going to assume you haven't found those berries, have you?
ja: ???: 木の実、まだ見つけてないんだろう?

key: Who knew such a simple task could prove to be so difficult?
en: Who knew such a simple task could prove to be so difficult?
ja: こんな簡単な仕事が、こんなに難しくなるとはね。

key: Hmm... Your reactions aren’t as entertaining as I would’ve hoped.
en: Hmm... Your reactions aren’t as entertaining as I would’ve hoped.
ja: うーん……君の反応、期待していたほど面白くないな。

key: You're no fun, that's for sure.
en: You're no fun, that's for sure.
ja: つまらない相手だってことは確かだ。

key: Okay, fine. I'm done messing with you.
en: Okay, fine. I'm done messing with you.
ja: まあいい。もう君をからかうのはやめだ。

key: Are you ready for the reveal, Trainer?
en: Are you ready for the reveal, Trainer?
ja: 種明かしの心構えはできてるか、トレーナー?

key: Well, it turns out...
en: Well, it turns out...
ja: 実はね……

key: I had the berries the whole time!
en: I had the berries the whole time!
ja: 木の実、ずっと僕が持ってたんだ!

key: Okay, I'm waiting for a better reaction...
en: Okay, I'm waiting for a better reaction...
ja: さあ、もっといい反応を待ってるんだけど……

key: Any day now...
en: Any day now...
ja: いつでもいいよ……

key: Hmph... This encounter continues to disappoint me.
en: Hmph... This encounter continues to disappoint me.
ja: フン……この出会いには、がっかりさせられてばかりだ。

key: Whatever the case, I'm a man of my word, I suppose.
en: Whatever the case, I'm a man of my word, I suppose.
ja: いずれにせよ、僕は約束を守る男のつもりだ。

key: Whether or not I think you deserve it, I'll show you the way home as promised.
en: Whether or not I think you deserve it, I'll show you the way home as promised.
ja: 君にふさわしいかどうかはさておき、約束通り、帰り道を教えてやろう。

key: ???: Just up there is the path ahead.
en: ???: Just up there is the path ahead.
ja: ???: すぐそこに、先へ続く道がある。

key: If you follow it, you'll find your way out of this dreary little dream.
en: If you follow it, you'll find your way out of this dreary little dream.
ja: それをたどれば、この陰気なちっぽけな夢から抜け出せる。

key: You'll be able to wake up, and freely roam around that merry existence you call home.
en: You'll be able to wake up, and freely roam around that merry existence you call home.
ja: 目を覚ませば、君が「家」と呼ぶ、あの陽気な世界を自由に歩き回れるようになるさ。

key: ???: Though, really, you could've just left at any time.
en: ???: Though, really, you could've just left at any time.
ja: ???: もっとも、本当はいつでも出て行けたんだけどね。

key: Did you not even notice that?
en: Did you not even notice that?
ja: それにすら気づかなかったのか?

key: I can't say that it's been pleasant meeting you, Trainer.
en: I can't say that it's been pleasant meeting you, Trainer.
ja: 君と出会えて楽しかった、とは言えないな、トレーナー。

key: When you first appeared, you were unusual enough for me to come and find you.
en: When you first appeared, you were unusual enough for me to come and find you.
ja: 最初に君が現れた時は、僕がわざわざ見つけに行くくらい、変わった存在だったんだけどね。

key: But it turns out, you weren’t at all the kind of trainer I was looking for.
en: But it turns out, you weren’t at all the kind of trainer I was looking for.
ja: でも結局、君は僕が探していたようなトレーナーじゃ全然なかった。

key: I suppose the silver lining is that we’ll never have to see each other again.
en: I suppose the silver lining is that we’ll never have to see each other again.
ja: まあ、唯一の救いは、もう二度とお互い会わずに済むってことかな。

key: Now come on, Trainer.
en: Now come on, Trainer.
ja: さあ、トレーナー。

key: Run along, before I change my mind.
en: Run along, before I change my mind.
ja: 気が変わらないうちに、さっさと行きな。

key: There’s nothing more for you here.
en: There’s nothing more for you here.
ja: ここにはもう、君のためのものは何もない。

key: ???: You’re still here, hmm?
en: ???: You’re still here, hmm?
ja: ???: まだここにいるのか?

key: As much as you must love being in my presence, there’s only space here for one.
en: As much as you must love being in my presence, there’s only space here for one.
ja: 僕といるのがそんなに好きなのはわかるけど、ここには一人分の場所しかないんでね。

key: Now, run along, Trainer.
en: Now, run along, Trainer.
ja: さあ、行きな、トレーナー。

key: Head on back to your boring little world, before I change my mind.
en: Head on back to your boring little world, before I change my mind.
ja: 気が変わらないうちに、君の退屈なちっぽけな世界に帰るんだ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
